title: Reviewed WSL runtime algorithm baseline
capture_notes: User-authorized reviewed baseline. Sanitized allowlisted aggregates only; no prompts, messages, reasoning text, URLs, identifiers, credentials, tool payloads, or raw output.
content:
# Reviewed WSL runtime algorithm baseline

Algorithm Observatory observed a bounded WSL window using read-only local contracts. The window contained 29 agent-browser structural events and one AuraCall structural status event. No Codex thread was selected, so this baseline makes no Codex runtime claim.

Directly observed patterns:

- agent-browser repeatedly applies state reconciliation to compare retained browser/tab state with current service state and record bounded change counts.
- agent-browser emits browser lifecycle events as a separate observable control signal.
- AuraCall exposes durable orchestration health through a read-only local status projection.

Learning boundary: treat these as source-labeled runtime mechanisms, not hidden model internals. Raw runtime events, prompts, message or reasoning text, URLs, profile/session/browser identifiers, credentials, tool arguments/results, and command output are excluded. Future learning should require a bounded observation window, stable aggregate, explicit review, provenance, ingestion evaluation, and retrieval readback.
